Run the full mortality forecast pipeline for a single cause

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_forecast.Rd

Executes 17 stages: data loading, array building, smoothing, Tucker3 calibration, model calibration, holdout comparison, model selection / ensemble, production forecast, bootstrap PIs, PI re-centering, coherence enforcement, fitted values, plots, disaggregation, diagnostics, and output saving.

Usage

run_forecast(data, config = NULL)

Arguments

data

Either a mort_data object (generic path) or a mort_config object (ONS path, backward compatible).

config

Optional mort_config object providing pipeline settings (forecast horizon, number of bootstrap simulations, etc.). Required when data is a mort_data object. Ignored when data is itself a mort_config.

Value

Invisibly, a list with all results (data, forecasts, PIs, tables).
